name: Natsuno Yuri
source:
Yuri has a serious personality. As a second year and the president of the Brass Band Club, she tries her best to be responsible. She trains her juniors, [url=/c98236]Kiko[/url] and [url=/c98237]Kanae[/url], with discipline. She has been shown to have a crush on [url=/c98234]Tsuyuri[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
